samples.question: Which deployment services must vendors be able to perform?
samples.answer: Vendors must be able to perform software installation, asset tagging and etching, device deployment and setup, and asset control reporting. Deployments must also include white-glove services: asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations. For software setup, Windows devices require Autopilot and Chromebooks require enrollment in Google Management.

samples.question: How quickly must warranty repairs or replacements be performed?
samples.answer: Warranty service, repairs, or replacements are expected to be completed at no cost within five business days after Dallas ISD reports the issue to the vendor. If repairs cannot be completed within that period, the District expects a temporary replacement device.

citations.quote: Warranties shall be equal to or exceed those offered to the general public. Dallas ISD expects that all warranty service and repairs or replacements will be performed by the awarded vendors at no cost within five (5) business days of the District reporting the issue to the vendor. Extension of warranty period and/or other adjustments will be expected when constant maintenance is required, or if replacement parts prove unsound. If the five business (5) day repair period cannot be achieved, the District expects to be provided a temporary replacement device.

samples.question: What proof must an authorized reseller submit with its proposal?
samples.answer: An authorized reseller must submit a copy of all factory-authorized repair and maintenance certifications with each proposal. Resellers must also provide demonstrated competencies and references for delivering the quantity of devices listed on the price sheet; supporting documentation may include past-project details, reference letters, and/or project plans.
